title: British Beef Pudding
description: A classic British dish, this beef pudding is a hearty meal made with ground beef and a dense, comforting pudding.

ingredients.name: Ground Beef
ingredients.notes: 80/20 lean to fat ratio works well for this dish

ingredients.name: Dense British Pudding Mix
ingredients.notes: Available at most British import stores

instructions: Brown the ground beef in a skillet over medium-high heat, breaking it up with a spoon as it cooks.
Once browned, drain excess fat and set aside.
In a separate bowl, mix together the dense British pudding mix and 2 cups of beef broth.
Pour the pudding mixture over the browned ground beef and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, then remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
While the pudding is baking, prepare the Yorkshire puddings according to package instructions.
To serve, place a scoop of the beef pudding on a plate, top with a Yorkshire pudding, and serve with gravy (made by thickening the beef broth with flour and a bit of fat).
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
